reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is physically problematic because Fe-B alloys do not contain aluminum, so a simple oxidation treatment cannot form an Al2O3 scale; the mechanism relies on a chemically impossible transformation.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clearly described with measurable outcomes, but it cannot meaningfully test the hypothesis because the starting material cannot form the claimed Al2O3 scale.
reasons.usefulness: The hypothesis is not useful because it is based on a fundamental material-science error (forming Al2O3 on an Al-free alloy), which would misdirect research effort.
